# ACCU

> ACCU is a professional community dedicated to promoting excellence and professionalism in C++ programming and software development.

ACCU hosts annual conferences in Bristol and Belfast featuring expert talks on C++, systems programming, and software architecture. The organization publishes two peer-reviewed journals, Overload and C Vu, which serve as authoritative sources for programming knowledge and best practices.

## Key Topics

- C++
- C++20
- Software Development
- Programming Languages
- Conference Videos

## Journals & Publications

- [ACCU Journals](https://accu.org/menu-overviews/journals-overview): Overview of ACCU's C Vu and Overload peer-reviewed journals
- [Overload Content by Issue](https://accu.org/journals/nonmembers/overload_issue_members): Overload journal archive indexed by issue with C++ articles
- [Overload Content by Article](https://accu.org/journals/nonmembers/overload_article_members): Overload journal articles indexed by topic and author
- [Overload Content by Author](https://accu.org/journals/nonmembers/overload_author_members): Overload journal articles indexed alphabetically by author
- [C Vu Content by Issue](https://accu.org/journals/nonmembers/cvu_issue_neutered): C Vu journal archive indexed by issue with programming content
